subject: Game Theory
title: What Is Fair?
description: Learn What Is Fair? in one minute.

hook.text: You and a stranger find $100. A 50-50 split seems fair—but what if you found it and they just watched?

buildup.text: Fairness has multiple definitions: equal split, proportional to effort, proportional to need.

discovery.text: Game theory shows that fairness norms are equilibrium selection devices—they help people coordinate.

twist.text: Different cultures have different fairness norms. There's no universal 'right' split that all humans agree on.

climax.text: Fairness matters in negotiation because people sacrifice their own payoff to enforce it.

quiz.question: Why do fairness norms matter in game theory?
options: They help select among multiple equilibria
